[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec impl (xs: List Int) : List Int :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | [x] => []
  | x :: xs' =>
    let derivative := x :: impl xs'
    derivative
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation xs
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_length: result.length = xs.length - 1 :=
    by
    induction' xs generalizing result
    simp [List.length]
    simp [impl]
    simp [List.length]
    simp [impl]
    simp [List.length]
    simp [impl]
    simp [List.length]
  rw [h_length]
  have h_reverse: result = (check_derivative xs.reverse).reverse :=
    by
    induction' xs generalizing result
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    simp [impl]
    have h_check_derivative: check_derivative xs.reverse = (0 :: impl xs.reverse).tail :=
      by
